entries.title: Mark 1:1
segments: ¶The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

entries.title: Mark 1:2
segments: As it is written in the Prophets: "Behold, I send My messenger before Your face, Who will prepare Your way before You."

entries.title: Mark 1:3
segments: "The voice of one crying in the wilderness: 'Prepare the way of the LORD; Make His paths straight.'"

entries.title: Mark 1:4
segments: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching a baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.

entries.title: Mark 1:5
segments: Then all the land of Judea, and those from Jerusalem, went out to him and were all baptized by him in the Jordan River, confessing their sins.

entries.title: Mark 1:6
segments: Now John was clothed with camel's hair and with a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.

entries.title: Mark 1:7
segments: And he preached, saying, "There comes One after me who is mightier than I, whose sandal strap I am not worthy to stoop down and loose.

entries.title: Mark 1:8
segments: "I indeed baptized you with water, but He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit."

entries.title: Mark 1:9
segments: ¶It came to pass in those days [that] Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

entries.title: Mark 1:10
segments: And immediately, coming up from the water, He saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending upon Him like a dove.

entries.title: Mark 1:11
segments: Then a voice came from heaven, "You are My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."

entries.title: Mark 1:12
segments: Immediately the Spirit drove Him into the wilderness.

entries.title: Mark 1:13
segments: And He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan, and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered to Him.

entries.title: Mark 1:14
segments: ¶Now after John was put in prison, Jesus came to Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,

entries.title: Mark 1:15
segments: and saying, "The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand. Repent, and believe in the gospel."

entries.title: Mark 1:16
segments: And as He walked by the Sea of Galilee, He saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

entries.title: Mark 1:17
segments: Then Jesus said to them, "Follow Me, and I will make you become fishers of men."

entries.title: Mark 1:18
segments: They immediately left their nets and followed Him.

entries.title: Mark 1:19
segments: When He had gone a little farther from there, He saw James the [son] of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also [were] in the boat mending their nets.

entries.title: Mark 1:20
segments: And immediately He called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired servants, and went after Him.

entries.title: Mark 1:21
segments: Then they went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath He entered the synagogue and taught.

entries.title: Mark 1:22
segments: And they were astonished at His teaching, for He taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.

entries.title: Mark 1:23
segments: ¶Now there was a man in their synagogue with an unclean spirit. And he cried out,

entries.title: Mark 1:24
segments: saying, "Let [us] alone! What have we to do with You, Jesus of Nazareth? Did You come to destroy us? I know who You are--the Holy One of God!"

entries.title: Mark 1:25
segments: But Jesus rebuked him, saying, "Be quiet, and come out of him!"

entries.title: Mark 1:26
segments: And when the unclean spirit had convulsed him and cried out with a loud voice, he came out of him.

entries.title: Mark 1:27
segments: Then they were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, "What is this? What new doctrine [is] this? For with authority He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him."

entries.title: Mark 1:28
segments: And immediately His fame spread throughout all the region around Galilee.

entries.title: Mark 1:29
segments: ¶Now as soon as they had come out of the synagogue, they entered the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

entries.title: Mark 1:30
segments: But Simon's wife's mother lay sick with a fever, and they told Him about her at once.

entries.title: Mark 1:31
segments: So He came and took her by the hand and lifted her up, and immediately the fever left her. And she served them.

entries.title: Mark 1:32
segments: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to Him all who were sick and those who were demon-possessed.

entries.title: Mark 1:33
segments: And the whole city was gathered together at the door.

entries.title: Mark 1:34
segments: Then He healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons; and He did not allow the demons to speak, because they knew Him.

entries.title: Mark 1:35
segments: Now in the morning, having risen a long while before daylight, He went out and departed to a solitary place; and there He prayed.

entries.title: Mark 1:36
segments: And Simon and those [who were] with Him searched for Him.

entries.title: Mark 1:37
segments: When they found Him, they said to Him, "Everyone is looking for You."

entries.title: Mark 1:38
segments: But He said to them, "Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because for this purpose I have come forth."

entries.title: Mark 1:39
segments: And He was preaching in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and casting out demons.

entries.title: Mark 1:40
segments: ¶Now a leper came to Him, imploring Him, kneeling down to Him and saying to Him, "If You are willing, You can make me clean."

entries.title: Mark 1:41
segments: Then Jesus, moved with compassion, stretched out [His] hand and touched him, and said to him, "I am willing; be cleansed."

entries.title: Mark 1:42
segments: As soon as He had spoken, immediately the leprosy left him, and he was cleansed.

entries.title: Mark 1:43
segments: And He strictly warned him and sent him away at once,

entries.title: Mark 1:44
segments: and said to him, "See that you say nothing to anyone; but go your way, show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing those things which Moses commanded, as a testimony to them."

entries.title: Mark 1:45
segments: However, he went out and began to proclaim [it] freely, and to spread the matter, so that Jesus could no longer openly enter the city, but was outside in deserted places; and they came to Him from every direction.
